items.title: Lock the film cast
items.detail: The current cast includes the updated Lizzie and Thuận at 1.46 m.

items.title: Check the film’s look
items.detail: The background and cast test passes and the edit comparisons are complete.

items.title: Measure the whole cut
items.detail: The baseline visibility audit covered all 58 cut rows and 2,109 pictures.

items.title: Lizzie’s right glove
items.detail: The cuff and forearm edge were corrected and checked.

items.title: Lizzie’s apron arm clearance
items.detail: No clipping above the 1 mm threshold in 2,075 pictures. Her wrists keep their marks.

items.title: Heart, hip and collar gestures
items.detail: The contact trial reached the intended marks but reintroduced forearm clipping.

items.title: Stage footing
items.detail: All 1,114 sampled supporting soles met the 0–3 mm target. The whole-cut check has reached 49 of 58 cut rows.

items.title: Stage numbers and props
items.detail: The posy handover, hat grips and remaining stage contacts are under review.

items.title: Right hand and wrist
items.detail: One trial cleared the clipping but introduced sharp wrist turns. A smoother route is in testing.

items.title: Shoes and sole shape
items.detail: The black finish is approved. The new sole reached 1 mm below the street in the first trial. The next test measures support from the actual sole.

items.title: Folded arms
items.detail: The new route reduced clipping. The forearms and hands still need to clear the jacket and sleeves.

items.title: Head movement and gaze
items.detail: The head turn during the kick still exceeds the motion limit.

items.title: Fight contacts and planted steps
items.detail: Check the blows, the cloak, and the shorter reach across the full fight.

items.title: Walk home
items.detail: Pin the supporting feet across the opening turn and the walk.

items.title: Make the chorus readable
items.detail: All six faces read in the tighter row trial. This staging still needs its final contact proof.

items.title: Join hands to shoulders
items.detail: The last trial had hidden shoulder clipping. A fit against the posed shoulders is in testing.

items.title: Verify the fixes across the whole cut
items.detail: Review the changed shots in motion and confirm the remaining faults are cleared.

items.title: Render and assemble the release candidate
items.detail: The full 2:55 cut is prepared. Rendering starts after the fixes pass.

items.title: Review the finished movie
items.detail: Check the final export for picture continuity, sound sync, and complete playback.
